title: Design System: Unslog — The Ticket Wallet

display.purpose: Headlines, nav links, buttons, tags, tabs, table headers — always uppercase, never body prose.

mono.purpose: Fit scores, dates, salaries, counts — every number a user scans to compare.

motion.name: score-fill
motion.purpose: The score circle's red fill rises on load/update; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: interactive-state
motion.purpose: Nav links, tags, and buttons transition state changes; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Jet-red filled action button, e.g. Save, Apply, Continue with Google.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1.5px solid #d7262d; background: #d7262d; color: #fffdf8; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 120ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(215,38,45,0.45); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Paper-surface, navy-bordered ticket-stub button, e.g. Review, Cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1.5px solid #13203a; background: #fffdf8; color: #13203a; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 120ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(215,38,45,0.45); }

components.name: Fit Score
components.description: Ink-stamped circular fit score (0-100); a jet-red fill rises from the bottom in proportion to the score. The system's signature high-scannability element.
components.html: 86
components.css: .ds-score { position: relative; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; background: #fffdf8; color: #13203a; border: 2px solid #a9a08a; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.2rem; transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-score-fill { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; height: 100%; background: #d7262d; opacity: 0.14; transform-origin: bottom; transition: transform 400ms ease-out; } .ds-score-num { position: relative; }

components.name: Tag — Cleared (navy stamp)
components.description: Navy-filled 'cleared' stamp for good/confirmed states (e.g. visa clear). Deliberately not green — replaced an off-world green during finish review.
components.css: .ds-tag-good { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid #13203a; border-radius: 3px; background: #13203a; color: #fffdf8; }

components.name: VOID Stamp Card
components.description: Closed/rejected pipeline card: the application stays fully visible at 72% opacity under a diagonal, hand-stamped VOID mark (SVG feTurbulence/feDisplacementMap distressed edge, not a clean box).
components.css: .ds-card-void { position: relative; background: #fffdf8; border: 1px solid #d9d2bf; border-radius: 3px; padding: 12px; opacity: 0.72; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: #13203a; } .ds-void-mark { position: absolute; top: 38%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-10deg); font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.6rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #b0191f; border: 2px solid #b0191f; outline: 1.5px solid #b0191f; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0 10px; opacity: 0.68; }

components.name: Pipeline Lane
components.description: A hard-cornered, top-bordered coupon-book lane holding application cards; turns carbon-purple only when it is the follow-up-due lane with cards waiting.
components.css: .ds-lane { background: #ece7d8; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px; border-top: 3px solid #a9a08a; display: grid; gap: 12px; } .ds-lane.ds-attention { background: #e7e0f3; border-top-color: #4b2e83; } .ds-lane-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; } .ds-lane-head h2 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #13203a; }

components.name: Tear Perforation
components.description: Dashed divider with punched-circle ends; the system's standing substitute for a plain rule or shadowed card edge.
components.css: .ds-tear { position: relative; border-top: 1.5px dashed #a9a08a; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-tear::before, .ds-tear::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -7px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f3efe4; } .ds-tear::before { left: -21px; } .ds-tear::after { right: -21px; }

narrative.overview:
Every job and application in Unslog is drawn as a travel document, not a SaaS record. The dashboard is the inside of a jet-age ticket wallet: coupon-stock paper underneath, carrier-navy structure holding it together, and jet red as the one committed signal color — stamped onto scores, printed on primary buttons, and burned into the "Today" boarding-pass summary. Carbon purple is held back for exactly one job: marking a duplicate sighting or a follow-up that's gone quiet, so that signal is never confused with the red of a primary action. Rejected or withdrawn applications are never deleted — they're VOIDed, stamped and kept in the lane, honest about what happened to them.

This system was chosen over "The Noticeboard Wall" in a direction tournament and replaces the dashboard's prior, untracked visual state wholesale; there is no earlier DESIGN.md to reconcile against. The build keeps the product's one load-bearing constraint — fit scores and visa/residency flags stay instantly scannable — by giving the score its own stamped, high-contrast circular slot and by giving visa tags their own tag-attention/tag-good treatment rather than burying either in body text. The product was renamed from "Callback" to "Unslog" after this system shipped (user-supplied name and brand sheet), with a new mark: a rounded-square tile holding an up-right arrow and two underline bars, built as a single-accent mark (tile and arrow+bars both riding --action) rather than the supplied sheet's two-accent ink/orange duotone. The wordmark text and mark shape are the fixed brand asset going forward; the mark's accent is explicitly not pinned to a fixed hue — it rides the system's single committed accent color, so the mark always matches the live world instead of carrying an older palette forward.
keyCharacteristics: Coupon-white paper ground with carrier-navy ink structure; jet red is the only accent allowed to carry primary action and live-status weight.
Perforated tear lines (dashed rule + punched circular ends) stand in for card dividers and section breaks.
Big Shoulders Display (condensed uppercase) for every label, heading, button, and tab; IBM Plex Sans for body copy; IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals for every score, date, salary, and count.
Flat throughout — no drop shadows anywhere in the system; depth comes from ink-heavy borders, dashed perforation, and the navy sidebar, never from elevation.
A diagonal, hand-stamped VOID mark (SVG turbulence filter, not a clean CSS box) covers closed/rejected pipeline cards without removing them.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Jet red is the only color allowed to signal "act on this," "this is live," or "this is the brand." Carbon purple never substitutes for it, even when both would be visually legible — purple means "duplicate or stale," never "go."

rules.name: The Stamped, Not Colored Rule
rules.body: A cleared/good state is rendered as a navy ink stamp (tag-good: navy fill, paper text) rather than a green badge. Green is held back for the Today health-check dots only. This replaced an earlier off-world generic-green tag-good during finish review.

rules.name: The Living Mark Rule
rules.body: The Unslog logo mark's accent is bound to var(--action), the system's single committed accent token, rather than a hue fixed to the mark itself. The mark's shape (rounded-square tile, up-right arrow, two underline bars) and the "Unslog" name are the fixed brand asset; its color is not — it always matches whichever world currently owns --action (jet red for The Ticket Wallet). Confirmed in PRODUCT.md's Brand Commitments.

rules.name: The All-Caps Label Rule
rules.body: Every UI label (nav, button, tag, tab, table header, field label) is set in uppercase Big Shoulders Display with positive letter-spacing. Body prose is never set in display face or uppercase.

rules.name: The Tabular Everything Rule
rules.body: Any number a user scans to compare — score, salary, date, count — is set in IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat Stock Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this system lifts off the page with a shadow. A card reads as a cut and printed piece of ticket stock lying flat, bordered by ink, not a floating surface.

dos: Do set every score, date, salary figure, and count in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals.
Do use the .tear perforation (dashed rule + punched ends) as the divider between a card's content and its action row, instead of a plain border or shadow.
Do keep jet red reserved for primary actions and the single "live/actionable" signal per view.
Do render closed/rejected pipeline items with the VOID stamp over an intact card — never delete or hide a closed application.
Do use carbon purple only for duplicate-sighting or follow-up-due signals; never as a second brand accent.
Do keep the Unslog logo mark's accent bound to var(--action) rather than a fixed hue of its own, so it always matches the live system's accent. Confirmed brand commitment per PRODUCT.md.
donts: Don't add a drop shadow anywhere in this system — depth comes from ink borders and the tear perforation, not elevation.
Don't render a "cleared"/good status as a green tag or badge; green is reserved for the Today health-check dots only.
Don't mix carbon purple and jet red as competing accents on the same element.
Don't set body prose in Big Shoulders Display or in uppercase; the display face is for labels and headings only.
